  [Life Sciences]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Life Sciences overview][188]
  **Real-World Data**
  [NLP-Enriched EHR Data Solutions][189] Large-scale, high-quality health data sets.
  **Real-World Evidence**
  [Real-World Evidence][190] Retrospective and prospective research by RWE experts.
  [Real-World Evidence Analytics Platform][191] SaaS application enabling efficient analysis of
  real-world data.
  **Point of Care Marketing**
  [Digital Health Media][192] Highly targeted brand awareness messaging in the EHR.*
* [Health Plans + Payers][193]
  [Health Plan Payers]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Health Plans + Payers overview][194]
  **Gap Closure**
  [Gap Closure Services][195] Proactive, clinically-driven services to help health plans and their
  network providers close care gaps.
  [Care Gap Alerting][196] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Provider Engagement Solutions][197] Streamlined payer-provider collaboration for better gap
  closure.
  **Risk Adjustment**
  [Health Equity Analytics][198] Go beyond Social Determinants of Health (SDoH).
  [Risk Adjustment Analytics][199] Analytics to find and prioritize gaps and opportunities.
  [Risk Mitigator][200] RADV audits - be prepared, not scared.
  [Comprehensive Submissions][201] One cloud-based data management platform for all government
  programs.
  [Utilization Analytics][202] Delivers visibility needed to monitor and manage key performance
  indicators.
  **Data Exchange + Coding**
  [eChart Courier][203] Automated electronic chart retrieval.
  [eChart Coder][204] Boost productivity and reduce costs with Veradigm eChart Coder.
  [eChart Integration and Analytics][205] Automated exchange of clinical data and medical record
  information for analysis.
  **Quality Management**
  [Quality Analytics][206] Proven analytic solution to help plans enhance Quality performance across
  their member base.
  [Risk Adjustment and Quality Management][207] Real-time visibility to monitor and manage your KPIs
  for risk and quality alike.
  **Clearinghouse + EDI**
  [Veradigm Payerpath][208] Claims and risk adjustment solution including an effective collaboration
  delivering streamlined EDI.
* [Healthcare Providers][209]
  [Healthcare Provider]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare Providers overview][210]
  **Our Platform**
  [Veradigm Suite][211] Explore Veradigm’s powerful healthcare solutions designed to streamline
  operations, improve patient care, and boost practice efficiency.
  **Streamline Practice Operations**
  [Practice Management][212] Simplified software for effortless scheduling, billing, and claims
  processing.
  [AI Patient Scheduling][213] Automate and optimize patient scheduling with artificial
  intelligence.
  **Improve Clinical Efficiency**
  [EHR Software][214] Adaptable ambulatory EHR platform that supports your clinical documentation
  and workflow needs.
  [ePrescribe][215] Affordable and certified e-Prescribing solution including controlled substances.
  [Gap Closure Alerting][216] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Clinical Data Registries][217] Registry participation for providers.
  [eChart Courier][218] Save time, reduce costs, and increase efficiency by automating medical chart
  retrieval.
  **Maximize Revenue**
  [Revenue Cycle Services][219] Let us handle billing, minimize denials, enhance coding, and ensure
  timely payments.
  [Coding Services][220] Get help to reduce staff burden and increase revenue - let our team manage
  coding for you.
  [Veradigm Payerpath][221] All-in-one revenue cycle management solution that features a top-tier
  clearinghouse.
  [Veradigm Intelligent Payments][222] Simplify patient billing and boost collections with
  intelligent, automated payments.
  **Engage Patients**
  [Patient Engagement Platform][223] Integrate with a mobile-first patient engagement platform.
  **Optimize Resources and Spend**
  [ERP Fiscal Management][224] Automate finance workflows and improve visibility into spend,
  reporting, and compliance.
  [ERP Point of Use][225] Track supply usage in clinical settings to reduce waste and improve
  accuracy.
  [ERP Supply Chain][226] Streamline purchasing and inventory with real-time visibility from
  requisition to delivery.
* [Health IT Vendors][227]
  [Veradigm Network]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare IT Vendor Solutions overview][228]
  **Powered by the Network**
  [Life Sciences][229] Empowering life science with trusted data and insights from the point of
  care.
  [Health Plans + Payers][230] Connecting payers to the Veradigm Network’s comprehensive, national
  provider footprint.
  [Providers][231] Integrated clinical & financial solutions for a healthier practice.
  **API Connectivity**
  [Veradigm Connect][232] Connect the latest health tech solutions with the physicians and patients
  who need them.
  [App Expo][233] Become one of hundreds of certified applications and devices for provider
  practices built on open APIs.
  [Diagnostic Ordering and Results Network (DORN)][234] Connecting EHR Vendors with Lab and
  Radiology centers.
  **Electronic Prescribing**
  [Veradigm ePrescribe Enterprise][235] Integrated, advanced, easy-to-use ePrescribing for EHR and
  HIT vendors.
* [Insights][236]
  [Two hands typing on a laptop]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Filter through all of Veradigm's Insights][237]
  **Veradigm Insights**
  [Blog Posts][238] Read through our collection of valuable insights.
  [Videos][239] Watch our videos to learn more about our offerings.
  [Thought Leadership][240] Read the latest healthcare insights from our team of subject matter
  experts.
  [Podcasts][241] Listen to our podcasts to hear healthcare insights from our team of experts.
  [Webinars][242] Watch our webinars to learn more about how we are transforming health,
  insightfully.
  **Resources**
  [RWE Publications][243] Read through our RWE publications and learn how we help clients.
  [Clinical Data Registries][244] Explore our registry publications and learn how we help clients.
  [*Smart Medicine* Podcast][245] Thought-provoking podcast dedicated to understanding the
  intersection of care and innovation
  **Trending Topics**
  [Value-Based Care][246] Comprehensive guide to value-based care, including use cases, relevant
  blog articles, white papers and more.
  [Real-World Evidence][247] Complete overview of real-world evidence, why it’s important, and how
  it’s used in healthcare.
  [Real-World Data][248] Thorough review of what real-world healthcare data is, how it’s collected,
  and how it’s used across the healthcare spectrum.
  [Payer Provider Relationships Guide][249] Discover the impact of payer-provider relationships on
  healthcare. Learn how collaboration improves patient care and addresses challenges.

## Accredited for quality

Optum programs meet rigorous healthcare industry standards for safety, reliable outcomes and
continuous improvement.

* [ACHC – Infusion Pharmacy gold seal] Learn more
  
  ### ACHC – Infusion Pharmacy
  
  Optum Infusion Pharmacy is accredited by the Accreditation Commission for Health Care (ACHC) for
  pharmacy services backed by rigorous quality standards. This designation recognizes our commitment
  to safety, accuracy and improved health outcomes.
  
  [View infusion services][72]
* [NABP Accredited Digital Pharmacy seal] Learn more
  
  ### NABP – Digital Pharmacy
  
  Optum Pharmacy is proud to be a National Association of Boards of Pharmacy (NABP) Accredited
  Digital Pharmacy. This independent, third-party verification demonstrates how our operations meet
  the highest standards for patients who count on convenient, reliable and safe online pharmacy
  services. 
  
  [View pharmacy services][73]
* [URAC Accreditation for Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) seal] Learn more
  
  ### URAC – Pharmacy Benefit Management

family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

[From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
Communication]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

## Share What You've Done, Learn What You Can Do

[
Explore more on
[EpicShare]
][7]
[From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
Communication]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

# Healthcare Empowered^{®}

Enabling the power of data to improve healthcare outcomes and economics

[Inovalon Payer Product Information page][128]

## Payers

Improve member care and outcomes while achieving greater performance with sophisticated analytics
and dynamic business intelligence.

[Inovalon Provider Product Information page][129]

## Providers

Optimize revenue cycle management, care quality management, and workforce management in one
single-sign-on, easy-to-use portal.

[Inovalon Pharmacy Product Information page][130]

## Pharmacies

Streamline pharmacy operations and improve performance with automated processing, real-time data
exchange, and electronic decision support.

[Inovalon Life Sciences Product Information page][131]

## Life Sciences

Optimize your product life cycle strategy and performance with industry-leading primary source data
and analytics solutions.

### Data has a story to tell.

## We give it a voice.^{®}

Inovalon empowers payers, providers, pharmacies, and life sciences organizations with data and
solutions to drive meaningful change in patient outcomes, business performance, and healthcare
economics.

[Request A Demo][132]

## Best in KLAS Quality Measurement

For health plan quality teams, every measure, gap, and deadline matters. Inovalon’s Best in KLAS
quality measurement solution helps health plans simplify reporting, improve measure accuracy, and
stay ready for HEDIS®, Star Ratings, and state quality programs.

[Read More ][133]
[Inovalon spiral with text "Customer Success"]

## One Workflow for Specialty Pharmacy Growth

Ardon Health was juggling three disconnected systems. The specialty pharmacy consolidated workflows
with Inovalon’s ScriptMed®, reducing friction for teams and building a stronger foundation to
support growth, patient care, and day-to-day pharmacy operations as volumes increase.

[Read Their Story ][134]
[Blue graphic with a white speedometer icon and the words Explore RCM ROI, highlighting healthcare
software, with glass-like structures on the left side.]

## Your Free RCM ROI Calculator

Run the numbers for your team’s potential denial reductions and ROI gains. Use our free calculator
to see your opportunities to strengthen financial health.

[Use the Calculator ][135]
[split image with "Healthcare Forecast" copy on the left and INOvators podcast logo on the right]

## What AI Could Mean for Patient Care

AI has the potential to improve access to care and ease pressure on clinicians, but only if
healthcare leaders protect patient trust along the way. Inovalon’s Chief Medical Officer shares how
AI agents may reduce admin burden and reshape patient care over the next 3–5 years.

[Watch Now ][136]

## Healthcare Insights, Ready When You Are

Catch up on expert-led webinars covering the issues shaping healthcare today, from regulatory
reporting and RADV audits to RCM, real-world data, research, and more. Get practical perspectives
you can use to stay informed, prepared, and ahead of what’s next.

[Watch Now ][137]

## Extensive Data, Trusted Solutions

Inovalon brings together national-scale connectivity, real-time primary source data access, and
advanced analytics to power our solutions. Our software enables meaningful impact across payer,
provider, pharmacy, and life sciences settings.

[Learn More][138]
[A computer monitor displaying a dashboard with various charts, graphs, and tables, including line
graphs, bar charts, circular charts, and a side navigation menu on the left.]

## Converged Quality

Measure quality and improve care with predictive analytics that enable early detection of quality
measure eligibility, to drive timely interventions.

[Learn More][139]

[A computer monitor displaying a sales management software interface with various tabs, forms, and
data entry fields for sales tracking and customer information management.]

## Claims Management Pro

Streamline and automate claims processing with all-payer visibility to track, monitor, and manage
appeals.

[Learn More][140]

[A computer monitor displays a healthcare dashboard with patient information and an adherence risk
gauge showing levels from low to high, highlighting the Moderate risk zone in yellow.]

## ScriptMed^{®} Specialty

Decrease time to fill and cost to serve, and improve medication adherence with adherence risk
predictions powered by machine learning.

[Learn More][141]

[A desktop monitor displaying a medical dashboard with a patient’s profile, showing a trend line
graph of weight readings over several dates and navigation menus on the side.]

## DataStream

Transform patient encounters with seamless data integration at the point of care informing
patient-centric decision-making.

[Learn More][142]

## See What Customers Have Said About Inovalon Solutions

Read what customers across the continuum of care have to say about Inovalon solutions.

[View All Customer Stories][143]
[View Customer Story][144]

As a long-time auditor and consultant in the industry, I’ve seen [Inovalon’s] software utilized by
many payers throughout the industry. I trust it because…it’s reliable, replicable, accurate, and
complete.

[A woman with curly hair smiles joyfully while holding a red apple in her hand, standing in a sunlit
field during golden hour, capturing a vibrant moment that feels as authentic as real world data.]
Terance Fowler Executive Director of Quality, Aetna/CVS Health
[View Customer Story][145]
[CVS Health logo with a red heart icon next to cvs Health in red and black, separated by a vertical
line from the purple aetna logo—representing trusted names in healthcare software—on a white
background.]
[View Customer Story][146]

You can really lean on Inovalon; it’s always been a collaborative effort. In the past, there would
have never been a day I would have taken off during HEDIS season – now I know I can step away for a
day or two and everything will be okay.

[A woman with curly hair smiles joyfully while holding a red apple in her hand, standing in a sunlit
field during golden hour, capturing a vibrant moment that feels as authentic as real world data.]
Davina Green HEDIS Manager
[View Customer Story][147]
[Logo of The HSC Health Care System with a blue square containing a heart and three yellow figures,
next to the text: “Health Services for Children with Special Needs, Inc.”.]
[View Customer Story][148]

The visibility to our claims status and what was being rerouted was important for me and for the
organization as a whole. We weren’t really scrambling like other providers might have been.

[A woman with curly hair smiles joyfully while holding a red apple in her hand, standing in a sunlit
field during golden hour, capturing a vibrant moment that feels as authentic as real world data.]
William Borrego Vice President of Revenue Cycle Operations at PAM Health
[View Customer Story][149]
[Blue and white PAM Health logo with a stylized path graphic to the left and the words PAM Health in
large blue capital letters on the right.]

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

### [ Pharmaceutical & Medical Supplies Distribution Services ][127]

[Pharmacist in a white coat holding a prescription bottle in a pharmacy, with shelves of medications
and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

### [ Pharmacy Services ][128]

[A medical professional in blue scrubs examines a brain scan image.]

### [ Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions ][129]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at
a computer.]

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

[ Read More ][133]
News & Stories

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

boosting income for the local community by 60%.

Unified Catalog, Observability, and Conversational Analytics

# The context
# platform for AI

The only data intelligence platform that gives AI semantic understanding, lineage, quality
indicators, business context, and conversational analytics.

[ Book Demo ][123] [ Start Tour ][124]
[ISG_Data_Intelligence_Exemplary_Hero]
Trusted by 25 of the Fortune 100
* [ Capabilities ][125]
* [ Case Study ][126]
* [ Connectors ][127]
* [ Customer Stories ][128]
* [ Industry Recognition ][129]
* [ Contact Us ][130]

## The missing layer between your data & your AI

It all comes together in one platform—knowledge graphs, data observability, conversational
analytics, and contract-first governance—so AI can scale with accuracy and control.
* Jump to card card1:Context layer
* Jump to card card2:Trust layer
* Jump to card card3:Access layer

Context layer

Federated knowledge graph gives every asset a semantic identity, so AI understands business meaning,
not just column names. Bottom-up cataloging across all sources, with a Steward Agent to maintain
definitions and contract-first governance.

Trust layer

Continuous monitoring is built into the platform. It validates data health in real time, enforces
data contracts, and provides AI agents with automated trust signals, enabling them to operate
without human checkpoints.

Access layer

Natural language interface (NL-to-SQL), context-aware and embedded in workflows, lets business users
query data in Slack or Teams, delivering instant, governed answers through approved templates and
real-time validation.

## Deploy in days, not months

Transform your data catalog into an intelligence platform: the only solution that combines a
federated knowledge graph, real-time quality and observability, conversational analytics, and
contract-first governance for agentic AI. Deploy in days with 100+ connectors, friendly UI, and
immediate value for business users and data teams alike.

### Discover and understand all your data instantly

**Data & IT Leaders **can eliminate 80% of time wasted searching for data with AI-powered natural
language search, federated knowledge graphs, and hierarchical glossaries with instant business
context – built on governed metrics, relationships, and business logic defined upfront.

### Pass audits without slowing AI innovation

**Data Quality & Governance** leaders can replace rigid validation workflows with watchlists that
provide visibility without blocking contributors, embed security policies directly in data
contracts, and maintain automated audit trails with field-level lineage.

### Activate AI agents with production-ready data

**AI/ML Engineering Leaders **can eliminate the 60% AI failure rate by enabling agents to verify
data through contracts, understand context through knowledge graphs, and monitor it with real-time
observability—delivering accurate and consistent results with transparency into how answers are
produced.

[ Start Tour ][131]

## One unified platform. Infinite agentic possibilities.

From data discovery to AI activation, empower every user with intelligent, governed access to your
enterprise knowledge graph.

## Enterprise-ready use cases for agentic AI, regulatory compliance, and self-service analytics
* Discover
* Trust
* Activate

### Discover, understand, & access all your data instantly

**Unified Data Catalog and Data Marketplace** for centralized discovery and ready-to-use data
products and contracts.

**Federated Knowledge Graph** with domain-specific ontologies to maintain local autonomy while
connecting to the enterprise semantic layer.

**Conversational Interface **dynamic question-and-answer interactions, allowing users to ask
follow-ups without switching reports.

**Data Access Request Management** for webhooks and use-case management for data access, reducing
workloads.

**Peer-to-Peer Sharing** between domain/sub-catalogs breaks down silos while maintaining governance.

**Chrome Plugin** provides comprehensive context and business definitions directly in BI dashboards.

### Build trust, mitigate risk, and ensure regulatory compliance

**Complete Data Lineage** with visualization connectors for semantic models and end-to-end tracking
of data transformations.

**Contract-First Data Products** with embedded security policies and automated violation detection
for data reliability.

**End-to-End Data Integrity** monitoring from ingestion to consumption with automated quality issue
resolution.

**Steward Agent** defines governed metrics and relationships, reducing semantic drift and ensuring
consistent analytics over time.

**AI Glossary Builder** for universal business language and automated term extraction from BI
dashboards.

**Built-in Compliance** with automated classification and audit trails for GDPR, CCPA, and BCBS 239
regulations.

### Activate trusted data with agents and automations

## The missing layer between your data & your AI

It all comes together in one platform—knowledge graphs, data observability, conversational
analytics, and contract-first governance—so AI can scale with accuracy and control.
* Jump to card card1:Context layer
* Jump to card card2:Trust layer
* Jump to card card3:Access layer

Context layer

Federated knowledge graph gives every asset a semantic identity, so AI understands business meaning,
not just column names. Bottom-up cataloging across all sources, with a Steward Agent to maintain
definitions and contract-first governance.

Trust layer

Continuous monitoring is built into the platform. It validates data health in real time, enforces
data contracts, and provides AI agents with automated trust signals, enabling them to operate
without human checkpoints.

Access layer

Natural language interface (NL-to-SQL), context-aware and embedded in workflows, lets business users
query data in Slack or Teams, delivering instant, governed answers through approved templates and
real-time validation.

## Deploy in days, not months

Transform your data catalog into an intelligence platform: the only solution that combines a
federated knowledge graph, real-time quality and observability, conversational analytics, and
contract-first governance for agentic AI. Deploy in days with 100+ connectors, friendly UI, and
immediate value for business users and data teams alike.

### Discover and understand all your data instantly

**Data & IT Leaders **can eliminate 80% of time wasted searching for data with AI-powered natural
language search, federated knowledge graphs, and hierarchical glossaries with instant business
context – built on governed metrics, relationships, and business logic defined upfront.

### Pass audits without slowing AI innovation

**Data Quality & Governance** leaders can replace rigid validation workflows with watchlists that
provide visibility without blocking contributors, embed security policies directly in data
contracts, and maintain automated audit trails with field-level lineage.

### Activate AI agents with production-ready data

**AI/ML Engineering Leaders **can eliminate the 60% AI failure rate by enabling agents to verify
data through contracts, understand context through knowledge graphs, and monitor it with real-time
observability—delivering accurate and consistent results with transparency into how answers are
produced.

enterprise knowledge graph.

## Built for business. Trusted by IT. Ready for AI.

Intelligent enterprises connect data, analytics, and AI across operations for faster, smarter
decisions. Ready to make the leap?

Alteryx One offers a clear path:


**Give teams an easy way to use enterprise data and AI while IT keeps control over security, scale,
and governance.**


**Reduce manual data prep time by up to 90%, automate analytics, and embed AI across the business.**


**Turn those data-backed decisions into impact with low-/no-code tools, AI assistance, and built-in
governance.**

[Discover Alteryx One][215]
Decision intelligence
Insights that drive action
Meaningful, measurable results
 
 

### Decision intelligence for executives

When the pressure’s on, you need to trust your data. Alteryx turns governed, AI-ready analytics into
insights you can stand behind, helping build an intelligent enterprise without the guesswork.

For executives, narrative cuts through the noise:
* [**Custom Reports**][216] explains the drivers, trends, and anomalies in clear language and
  updates as data changes.
* [**Auto Insights Playbooks**][217] surface high-value use cases from your own data and build
  reports in minutes, so you can test scenarios, choose trade-offs, and push actions to teams at
  enterprise scale.

[ Discover Generative AI ][218]
 
 

### Insights that drive action

Turn raw data into direction. Take advantage of 6 major platform integrations (Snowflake,
Databricks, AWS, Google, SAP, and Salesforce), along with 100+ prebuilt connectors and in-database
processing.

Analytic apps let business users run governed processes on demand, push results into downstream
systems, and collaborate in one view.

When AI knows your business, you get automation that allows for reliable decisions.

[ Get AI-Ready ][219]
 
 

### Meaningful, measurable results

Move from manual processes to proven impact. Transparent, governed workflows that standardize
analytics and reduce manual effort help you save time, cut millions in costs annually, and improve
efficiency at scale.

“What took my team almost a year to complete is now replicable and done in a matter of weeks.”

— Nikita Atkins, Data Science Global Leader, GHD

[ Start Now ][220]
 

## Capabilities that enable AI readiness at scale

Put data and AI to work for you. Connect systems, prep and blend data [**up to 100x faster**][221],
automate repeatable work, and keep lineage and controls in place. Alteryx One is a full-spectrum
analytics platform with 3 core capabilities that allow you to:

Prepare

Connect, clean, contextualize

Analyze

Explore, explain, share

Act

Forecast, simulate, operationalize

These capabilities have helped Alteryx users cut up to 70% of costs and save up to $2.2M annually.

 

[Discover Alteryx One][222]

### Data integration and AI-ready preparation

Create a unified view out of ERPs, CRMs, lakes, and files. Alteryx lets you connect enterprise apps
like Oracle and Microsoft without copying data. Automate prep with low-/no-code workflows, add
business context, and enforce governance and lineage to publish AI-ready datasets. Benefits include:
* Improved accuracy
* Faster analysis
* A single source of truth for teams

[Prepare Your Data][223]

HCP Lookup

### Find and contact any healthcare provider in the US.

Your reps spend hours tracking down a physician and still end up leaving a voicemail with someone
who has no idea who makes decisions. Ampliz gives them a verified email, direct phone, and full
practice data for any provider in the US, filtered by specialty, ownership, and procedure codes.

### Reach the people who control purchasing, budgets, and operations.

The VP of Operations at a 300-bed hospital is not in your CRM. Ampliz is. Search any title, filter

FAQ

## Everything you need to

### How is Ampliz different from ZoomInfo or Apollo?

General B2B platforms are not built around the data fields that healthcare outreach requires. NPI
numbers, specialty and sub-specialty filters, procedure codes, et al - these are not filters you can
add to a general B2B tool. Healthcare-specific platforms like Definitive Healthcare and Hl.co focus
on analytics and market intelligence, not outbound activation - they weren't built for the sales and
marketing motions that drive pipeline. Ampliz was built specifically for healthcare GTM. The data
model, the verification methodology, and the filters were all designed around how healthcare
organizations are structured and how the people inside them are reached.

### How current and accurate is the data?

Every record is re-verified on a 30-day cycle. Email addresses are tested through NeverBounce and
ZeroBounce. Phone numbers go through proprietary validation software. LinkedIn profiles are checked
for job changes via API. NPI records are cross-referenced against the federal registry. Addresses
run through NCOA. When sources conflict, a researcher investigates manually.

### What happens if a contact turns out to be wrong?

Flag it. Every contact your team flags triggers a manual investigation by our research team. The
record is verified, corrected, or removed, and that fix improves the data for every user on the
platform. That is how a quality data architecture is supposed to work. Your credit comes back
immediately, though.

### How does the credit model work?

One credit equals one contact. Your team can browse the entire platform, view practice statistics,
hospital analytics, referral patterns, and specialty distributions without spending a single credit.
Credits are only used when someone reveals contact details or exports a record. Flag a wrong contact
and the credit comes back.

### We already have a contact list. Can Ampliz clean it up?

Yes. Upload what you have: NPI numbers, names, email addresses, or practice names, and Ampliz
matches and enriches against our master file of 20M+ healthcare contacts. Enriched files are
returned within minutes. Match rates are reported transparently so you know exactly what was found
before your reps make a single call.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

[See how we’re connecting care][52]

## Bringing our Purpose to Life

Our mission to save and sustain lives is reflected in our business priorities and our commitment to
be an agent of change at a global level. This means doing what is right for our planet, our patients
and customers, our teams and our communities. We put this commitment into action through high-impact
philanthropy, diversity, equity and inclusion, nurturing partnerships with the healthcare community
and striving for the highest standards of corporate responsibility.

### Our Leadership

Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet our commitments – every
day and everywhere.

lasting value for the communities we serve.

# Your IT partner for healthcare AI and digital transformation

Edenlab is a software development and IT consulting company focused on driving digital innovation
and bridging technology gaps in healthcare — from single organizations to national-scale systems. We
partner with providers, payers, TPAs, health IT vendors, life sciences companies, consultancies, and
government agencies.

[ Contact us ][68]
[Darnytsia] [Universitetats Klinikum] [MasterCard][MasterCard] [Raiffeisen Bank][Raiffeisen Bank]
[Zoadigm][Zoadigm] [Heals][Heals] [Elation][Elation] [Ministry of Health of Ukraine][Ministry of
Health of Ukraine] [Ludwig Boltzmann Gesellschaft][Ludwig Boltzmann Gesellschaft] [Phoenix
Children's Hospital][Phoenix Children's Hospital]

## Can't move fast enough because your data, workflows, and compliance infrastructure aren't keeping
## up?

Edenlab bridges interoperability and AI-ready healthcare infrastructure, solving three key
challenges where organizations get stuck.

### Self-service BI and advanced analytics

We design and implement end-to-end AI-powered analytics ecosystems that turn raw healthcare data
into meaningful insights and enable timely, data-driven decision-making without technical barriers.

[ Data analytics services ][69] [ Analytics product development ][70]

### Healthcare operation automation

We create intelligent digital workflows that enhance complex manual processes, from clinical
documentation management to prior authorization and claims validation, reducing manual effort and
minimizing errors.

[ System development ][71] [ Agentic process automation ][72]

### Data exchange regulatory compliance

We build FHIR® layers that address ONC and Gematic compliance for product vendors, streamline claim
processing and reporting according to CMS for payers, and enable secure connectivity with HIE/HIN
for providers.

[ Regulatory compliance ][73] [ Healthcare interoperability ][74]

### Healthcare data modernization and enablement

We turn disconnected legacy data into semantically interoperable, AI-ready assets and make them
truly usable, enabling teams to discover, access, and activate data where it’s needed most.

[ Data platform migration ][75] [ Healthcare integrations ][76]

### Data storage solutions

Clinical data repositories Master patient indexes (MPI)
Medical provider directories Medicine and drug registers

information systems Clinical decision support systems [Claim & Billing software][84]

software

### Patient-facing software

Patient portals Telehealth solutions
Remote patient monitoring Chronic disease management
[Contact us][87]

## The value we bring through exclusive healthcare focus

### Deep understanding of US, EU, and Middle East healthcare markets

In each region, we have delivered digital transformation solutions for healthcare, including
large-scale interoperability projects that required deep knowledge of local regulations, healthcare
ecosystems, key stakeholders, and cross-organizational workflows.

[HIPAA][HIPAA] [GDPR][GDPR] [ISO 27001][ISO 27001]

### [ Structured approach to complex challenges ][88]

We start by understanding the real problem, often uncovering ecosystem-level constraints rather than
isolated project symptoms. With a strong team drawn from across the healthcare industry, we
interpret these constraints and turn them into sound architectures. Lean thinking then allows us to
deliver clean, scalable systems without unnecessary spending. This is how we’ve solved challenges
such as building robust FHIR analytics and enabling AI across complex medical contexts.

### [ Own accelerator for your custom healthcare solutions ][89]

Developed through extensive healthcare data work, our ONC- and Gematik-certified Kodjin Data
Platform provides a proven foundation that reduces costs, implementation risks and can significantly
accelerate solution delivery.

[Drummond Certified][Drummond Certified] [gematik – National Digital Health Agency][gematik –
National Digital Health Agency]

### [ Proven competence in HL7 FHIR services ][90]

We’ve been working with FHIR since its early days, bringing hands-on experience from national-scale
interoperability projects, including HIE implementations in Ukraine and the Middle East.

# Your IT partner for healthcare AI and digital transformation

Edenlab is a software development and IT consulting company focused on driving digital innovation
and bridging technology gaps in healthcare — from single organizations to national-scale systems. We
partner with providers, payers, TPAs, health IT vendors, life sciences companies, consultancies, and
government agencies.

## Can't move fast enough because your data, workflows, and compliance infrastructure aren't keeping
## up?

Edenlab bridges interoperability and AI-ready healthcare infrastructure, solving three key
challenges where organizations get stuck.

### Self-service BI and advanced analytics

We design and implement end-to-end AI-powered analytics ecosystems that turn raw healthcare data
into meaningful insights and enable timely, data-driven decision-making without technical barriers.

[ Data analytics services ][69] [ Analytics product development ][70]

### Healthcare operation automation

We create intelligent digital workflows that enhance complex manual processes, from clinical
documentation management to prior authorization and claims validation, reducing manual effort and
minimizing errors.

[ System development ][71] [ Agentic process automation ][72]

### Data exchange regulatory compliance

We build FHIR® layers that address ONC and Gematic compliance for product vendors, streamline claim
processing and reporting according to CMS for payers, and enable secure connectivity with HIE/HIN
for providers.

[ Regulatory compliance ][73] [ Healthcare interoperability ][74]

### Healthcare data modernization and enablement

We turn disconnected legacy data into semantically interoperable, AI-ready assets and make them
truly usable, enabling teams to discover, access, and activate data where it’s needed most.

### Deep understanding of US, EU, and Middle East healthcare markets

In each region, we have delivered digital transformation solutions for healthcare, including
large-scale interoperability projects that required deep knowledge of local regulations, healthcare
ecosystems, key stakeholders, and cross-organizational workflows.

[HIPAA][HIPAA] [GDPR][GDPR] [ISO 27001][ISO 27001]

### [ Structured approach to complex challenges ][88]

We start by understanding the real problem, often uncovering ecosystem-level constraints rather than
isolated project symptoms. With a strong team drawn from across the healthcare industry, we
interpret these constraints and turn them into sound architectures. Lean thinking then allows us to
deliver clean, scalable systems without unnecessary spending. This is how we’ve solved challenges
such as building robust FHIR analytics and enabling AI across complex medical contexts.

interoperability projects, including HIE implementations in Ukraine and the Middle East.

AI analytics

## Ask hard questions, get reliable answers

Anyone can ask in plain language, from a quick metric to a multi-step cohort breakdown. Answers come
from your governed definitions, so the numbers match your dashboards.

[Guido Stark]
Guido Stark Head of Data, World Vision New Zealand
I'm seriously impressed with Holistics AI capabilities! It doesn't just fetch documentation, it
understands the content and generates working solutions.

### AI summarizes any dashboard

AI reads the dashboard and adds a plain-English summary on top, flagging what changed and where to
look next.

Ask user: Which metric do you want for “how did we do” across over the last few weeks

Please answer the question below

Thinking
* Revenue/MRR by product Weekly revenue trend across products
* New subscriptions by products Weekly new subs across products
* Net subscriptions by products New minus churn by week
* Active/paying subscriptions by product Current paying subs trend by week
* Something else:
Ask anything about your data…

### AI asks before it guesses

When a request is unclear, Holistics AI asks what you meant, offering the likely options to pick
from or letting you type your own.

### See Holistics AI in action

Watch it answer live, then trace every number back to the metric it came from.

[ Explore AI analytics ][77]
Self-service BI

## Self-service exploration that breaks nothing

### Explore without waiting on the data team

Business users slice, drill, and combine metrics on datasets your team curates, without SQL,
tickets, or numbers that disagree with the dashboard next door.

[Insan Ramadhan]
Insan Ramadhan Data Team Manager, Qoala
The business user doesn't need to query anymore... they can just drag and drop metrics. This makes
data more accessible across the business.
[Drill down and through]

### Drill down and through

Break down by any dimension, then jump to the detail dashboard.

[View underlying data]

### View underlying data

Click into any number to see the exact rows behind it.

[Take action from any row]

### Take action from any row

Open a CRM record, send a pre-filled email, or jump to another dashboard, right from your table.

### Put self-service in your users' hands

See what business users can answer on their own, and how curated datasets keep them on track.

[ Explore self-service BI ][78]
Semantic layer

## One semantic layer under every answer

### Define it once, and AI can trust it

Your metrics and logic live in one place your team controls, so Holistics AI answers from those
definitions instead of guessing at raw tables.

> The semantic layer is Holistics' biggest draw because I was able to build reusable models,
> dimensions, metrics, and then describe them as code.

[Sterling Paramore]
Sterling Paramore Sr Staff Data Engineer, Mainspring Energy
ecommerce.aml

Model orders {
  table_name: 'ecommerce.orders'

  dimension status     { type: 'text' }
  dimension created_at { type: 'datetime' }

  measure revenue {
    type: 'number'
    definition: @aql sum(order_items.quantity * products.price) ;;
  }
}

// assemble models into a governed dataset
Dataset ecommerce {
  models: [orders, order_items, products, users]
  relationship(order_items.order_id > orders.id)
  relationship(order_items.product_id > products.id)
}

one definition · compiles to native SQL · governs every surface

### A query language built for your semantic layer

Query it in [AQL][79], where every metric is an object that composes like a function, so you build
new metrics on top of existing ones instead of copy-pasting SQL.

> I'd score AQL a 9 or 10, up there with the best tools I've used. We can define metrics based on
> other metrics, stacking them on top of each other, and still retain visibility into the raw data.

[Ian McLaren]
Ian McLaren Business Intelligence Engineer, DNSFilter
“What’s LTV by plan?”

metric revenue =
  sum(order_items.quantity * products.price)

metric arpu =
  safe_divide(revenue, count(users.id))   // builds on revenue

metric ltv =
  arpu * avg(users.lifespan_months)       // builds on arpu

each metric builds on the last · compiles to native SQL

### Access your semantic layer from any AI

Query your metrics from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or your own app over MCP and APIs. Every tool reads
the same definitions, so the answers agree.

ChatGPT [ See connector ][80]
Claude [ See connector ][81]
Cursor [ See connector ][82]

[Claude]
[Cursor]

### Go deeper on the semantic layer

See how defining a metric once keeps every dashboard, query, and AI answer in sync.

[ Explore the semantic layer ][83]
Analytics as-code

## Manage BI the way you ship software

Define models, metrics, and dashboards as code in Git. Branch a change, open a pull request, and
roll it back the moment something looks wrong.

[Everything as code]

### Everything as code

Define everything in AML, from models to dashboards, so your analytics is text you can read, review,
and reuse.

[Version control]

### Version control

Full history on every change, with one-operation rollback when something breaks.

[Branch, review, deploy]

### Branch, review, deploy

Real pull-request review on your business logic before it hits production.

### Build your BI with coding agents

Point Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor at your BI codebase.

Or use our in-browser Development Copilot to build models, metrics, and dashboards.

See a change go from a branch to a pull request to production, all in version control.

## Embed analytics your customers trust

Ship white-labeled dashboards and self-service inside your own product, with per-tenant security

### Embed analytics that feels native

White-label dashboards and portals that match your product's look and feel, from a single dashboard
to a full self-serve mini-BI.

> Because of the quality of your platform, it really feels native for our end users, and so they're
> very happy about it.

[Rob Winters]
Rob Winters Head of Data, Lepaya

### Ask AI, embedded

Let your customers ask questions in plain language inside your product, answered from the same
metrics that power their dashboards.

### Embed analytics in your product

See how product teams ship white-labeled dashboards and AI inside their own apps.

Semantic layer

## One semantic layer under every answer

### Define it once, and AI can trust it

Your metrics and logic live in one place your team controls, so Holistics AI answers from those
definitions instead of guessing at raw tables.

> The semantic layer is Holistics' biggest draw because I was able to build reusable models,
> dimensions, metrics, and then describe them as code.

[Sterling Paramore]
Sterling Paramore Sr Staff Data Engineer, Mainspring Energy
ecommerce.aml

Model orders {
  table_name: 'ecommerce.orders'

  dimension status     { type: 'text' }
  dimension created_at { type: 'datetime' }

  measure revenue {
    type: 'number'
    definition: @aql sum(order_items.quantity * products.price) ;;
  }
}

// assemble models into a governed dataset
Dataset ecommerce {
  models: [orders, order_items, products, users]
  relationship(order_items.order_id > orders.id)
  relationship(order_items.product_id > products.id)
}

one definition · compiles to native SQL · governs every surface

### A query language built for your semantic layer

Query it in [AQL][79], where every metric is an object that composes like a function, so you build
new metrics on top of existing ones instead of copy-pasting SQL.

> I'd score AQL a 9 or 10, up there with the best tools I've used. We can define metrics based on
> other metrics, stacking them on top of each other, and still retain visibility into the raw data.

[Ian McLaren]
Ian McLaren Business Intelligence Engineer, DNSFilter
“What’s LTV by plan?”

metric revenue =
  sum(order_items.quantity * products.price)

metric arpu =
  safe_divide(revenue, count(users.id))   // builds on revenue

metric ltv =
  arpu * avg(users.lifespan_months)       // builds on arpu

each metric builds on the last · compiles to native SQL

Query your metrics from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or your own app over MCP and APIs. Every tool reads
the same definitions, so the answers agree.

## Every project still starts with the same manual work

[Inven founders]
Ekku, Niilo, and Tommi
Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

Since then, we’ve worked with 1,000+ M&A teams and spoken to thousands of professionals across
private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

## Every project still starts with the same manual work

[Inven founders]
Ekku, Niilo, and Tommi
Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

Since then, we’ve worked with 1,000+ M&A teams and spoken to thousands of professionals across
private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

news, and more.

company status.
